selection_policy: Three preselected thresholds 0.2,0.3,0.4 bracket and nest around the user-defined threshold 0.35; selection made before reading books. Other event markets intentionally omitted to keep the LP and request budget bounded.
source_limitations: The API and series PDF differ on exceptional expiration timing; the application does not assert which source overrides.
The PDF fallback formula is preserved verbatim; the application does not calculate it or silently infer its unit convention.
Settlement reference values are modeled on the real line, not a presumed decimal lattice.
Receipt timestamps do not reveal exchange quote update times.
This development case was inspected during parser construction; it is not an unseen holdout.
